entries.subject: Zhang et al. (2024)'s JWST MIRI LRS phase curve (GO 2508) as a map of longitude
entries.finding: Read on 2026-10-15. The phase curve is not drawn: its fit is second order and printed only as derived numbers (a night side of 4 +/- 8 ppm and a hot spot 11 +/- 5 degrees east), which do not determine the curve, so it cannot be redrawn as a map. Its eclipse depth, 79 +/- 4 ppm, sets the Rock model dataset instead (source/science/zhang-2024/dayside-5-12um.json). Lee et al. (2026) revise the mass and radius only and report no phase curve.
entries.revisitWhen: A paper prints a first-order fit of the phase curve, or its full Fourier terms.
